==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Avalonia&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/AvaloniaTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=Avalonia&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using Avalonia.Controls;

// Verify.Avalonia: Renders an Avalonia control headlessly to png, alongside a text snapshot of its visual tree.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.Avalonia
// Note: The test project needs [assembly: AvaloniaTestApplication(typeof(TestAppBuilder))] once,
// and a builder that calls .UseSkia() and UseHeadless(new() { UseHeadlessDrawing = false }).
// Note: Avalonia's headless test host needs the test project to be an exe, which both xUnit and
// NUnit already set here.
// Note: VerifierSettings.UseSsimForPng() stops small rendering differences between operating
// systems from failing a test.
// Note: VerifyAvalonia.IncludeThemeVariant() in the module initializer renders every test light
// and dark, as #light and #dark snapshots.
// Note: VerifyAvalonia.AddAvaloniaConvertersForAssemblyOfType<T>() registers converters for the
// controls of a third party library.
// Note: An app project exposing controls to the tests needs an InternalsVisibleTo for the test
// assembly.
public class AvaloniaTests
{
    // A control is verified twice over: a png of what it renders, and text holding its visual
    // tree, so a binding that stopped producing text shows up as a readable diff.
    // Not run by default: an Avalonia render needs the method attributed AvaloniaFact (xUnit) or
    // AvaloniaTest (NUnit), and the test assembly needs an AvaloniaTestApplication attribute naming an
    // AppBuilder that calls UseSkia and sets UseHeadlessDrawing to false.
    [Fact(Skip = "an Avalonia render needs the method attributed AvaloniaFact (xUnit) or AvaloniaTest (NUnit), and the test assembly needs an AvaloniaTestApplication attribute naming an AppBuilder that calls UseSkia and sets UseHeadlessDrawing to false.")]
    public Task UserControl()
    {
        var control = new UserControl
        {
            Width = 200,
            Height = 100,
            Content = new TextBlock
            {
                Text = "Welcome to Avalonia!"
            }
        };
        return Verify(control);
    }

    // The text snapshot lists each child with the properties that differ from their defaults,
    // so a layout change is legible even when the two pngs look the same.
    // Not run by default: an Avalonia render needs the method attributed AvaloniaFact (xUnit) or
    // AvaloniaTest (NUnit), and the test assembly needs an AvaloniaTestApplication attribute naming an
    // AppBuilder that calls UseSkia and sets UseHeadlessDrawing to false.
    [Fact(Skip = "an Avalonia render needs the method attributed AvaloniaFact (xUnit) or AvaloniaTest (NUnit), and the test assembly needs an AvaloniaTestApplication attribute naming an AppBuilder that calls UseSkia and sets UseHeadlessDrawing to false.")]
    public Task ControlTree()
    {
        var control = new UserControl
        {
            Content = new StackPanel
            {
                Spacing = 10,
                Children =
                {
                    new TextBlock
                    {
                        Text = "Welcome to Avalonia!"
                    },
                    new Button
                    {
                        Content = "Press me"
                    }
                }
            }
        };
        return Verify(control);
    }
}

==== interactions

Info avalonia-mvvm: Many Avalonia and WPF projects use CommunityToolkit.Mvvm. Verify.CommunityToolkit.Mvvm snapshots its observable properties and commands readably, rather than as generated members.
